title: Please list top two sets of cards with their IDs that have Italian-language
question: Please list top two sets of cards with their IDs that have Italian-language cards and are located in the Shadowmoor block in alphabetical order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_110, s.XCL_095
FROM sets s
JOIN cards c ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072
WHERE s.XCL_097 = 'Shadowmoor'
  AND f.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
GROUP BY s.XCL_095, s.XCL_110
ORDER BY s.XCL_110
LIMIT 2
